title: Purchaser asks Gemini Furniture for 12 desks; confirming above the 5 000 threshold sends the order to approval
_seedNote: uses the demo seed (Gemini Furniture, Desk Combination 420.00 vendor price, approval on at 5 000); creates its own RFQ

steps.name: New RFQ: numbered, status Request for quotation
Add a line: Desk Combination x 12 at Gemini's price
steps._note: read-only totals render as input values, which ui.textPresent does not read; the oql row proves them

oql.label: the vendor price filled the line: 12 x 420.00 = 5 040.00 untaxed
oql.sql: SELECT COUNT(o.ID) AS n FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrder AS o WHERE o/Purchasing.PurchaseOrder_Vendor/Partners.Partner/Name = 'Gemini Furniture' AND o.Status = 'RFQ' AND o.AmountUntaxed = 5040

steps.name: Confirm order: above the threshold, it goes to a purchase manager

oql.label: an approval task is open for purchase managers
oql.sql: SELECT COUNT(t.ID) AS n FROM System.WorkflowUserTask AS t WHERE t.State = 'Created' OR t.State = 'InProgress'

steps.name: Save: back on the list, the order reads To approve

outcome.label: Gemini's 12-desk order waits for approval at 5 040.00 untaxed
outcome.sql: SELECT COUNT(o.ID) AS n FROM Purchasing.PurchaseOrder AS o WHERE o/Purchasing.PurchaseOrder_Vendor/Partners.Partner/Name = 'Gemini Furniture' AND o.Status = 'ToApprove' AND o.AmountUntaxed = 5040
